Table of definitions provided under each Federal Registrar (FR) notice

Source: R/tab-definitions.R
tab_definitions.Rd

List containing separate tables of Definitions for each FMP with associated FR notice for reference

Usage

tab_definitions(data = fishhist, FMP_filter)

Arguments

data

A dataframe (default=fishhist)

FMP_filter

Filter to FMP of interest

Value

A flextable object

Examples

tab_definitions(fishhist,
   FMP_filter = "SNAPPER-GROUPER FISHERY OF THE SOUTH ATLANTIC REGION")
